definitions.explanation: The physical size or scale of something. Formed from the adjective 大きい by replacing い with さ.

examples.japanese: この{箱|はこ}の{大|おお}きさはどのくらいですか。
りんごの{大|おお}きさがそれぞれ{違|ちが}う。
examples.english: The apples are each a different size.

examples.japanese: {靴|くつ}の{大|おお}きさが{合|あ}わなくて、{足|あし}が{痛|いた}い。
examples.english: The shoe size doesn't fit, so my feet hurt.

notes:
FORMATION:
{大|おお}きい (big) → {大|おお}きさ (size). The ～さ suffix converts い-adjectives into nouns expressing degree or extent: {高|たか}い → {高|たか}さ (height), {長|なが}い → {長|なが}さ (length), {広|ひろ}い → {広|ひろ}さ (width/spaciousness).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{大|おお}きさが{違|ちが}う (to differ in size)
・{大|おお}きさが{同|おな}じ (to be the same size)
・{大|おお}きさを{測|はか}る (to measure the size)
